runs.command: ruff check <six exact process-slice paths> && PYTHONPATH=eva2/src:eva2 pytest -q -s <service, tool-free child, delegated contract and workboard tests>
runs.environmentBoundary: Clean Git archive of implementation commit 9898926 using the exact product Pydantic AI 2.32.1 environment.
Clean Git archive of implementation commit 9898926; fresh disposable PostgreSQL 16.13 in tmpfs; exact product Pydantic AI 2.32.1 environment; database downgraded and container removed after the run.
Separate candidate environment with Pydantic AI 2.34.0; providerless only.
Fresh disposable PostgreSQL 16.13 with Pydantic AI 2.34.0; compatibility evidence only.
Independent reviewer-created disposable PostgreSQL 16.13 route plus source and static inspection.
Independent product-lock contract/runner/service rerun plus source and static inspection.
Independent non-PostgreSQL rerun and workboard wording/status inspection.

verifiedOutcomes: A providerless, tool-free Pydantic child runs in a real separate OS process.
Two concurrent worker processes cross one durable PostgreSQL call-start fence and produce one model call.
The child receives a minimal explicit environment; parent test DSN, inline DSN, OpenAI and Anthropic keys and a secret canary are absent.
A hard process death after durable claim but before call-start leaves claimed work reclaimable after lease expiry and produces one later model call.
SIGTERM during the model call becomes an honest ambiguous/stopped card and is not replayed.
SIGKILL after call-start is not replayed and becomes contact_lost after the lease expires.
Unsupported process signal handling fails service startup closed.
Raw task text, work identifiers and the DSN are absent from process arguments and process output.
nonClaims: No external model provider, provider network cancellation, provider bill or price accounting was tested.
There is no production provider factory, long-running release entrypoint, Compose service or managed-B deployment.
The minimal environment is proven in the test launcher; no production launch manifest enforces it yet.
A separate process is not a sandbox; no egress, CPU, memory or per-task process isolation is proven.
A hard-killed external call is not recovered; Eva reports uncertainty and does not blindly repeat it.
No task can yet be started, followed or stopped from Eva chat.
Migration 4e_0003 remains a post-freeze candidate; managed B remains on the earlier schema authority.
This is source-tested evidence, not product-live proof or user acceptance.
